Determine if the given Claim is SUPPORT, REFUTE, or NOT ENOUGH INFO based on the scientific evidence.

Claim: 1,000 genomes project enables mapping of genetic sequence variation consisting of rare variants with larger penetrance effects than common variants.
Thought 1: I need to search for information about the 1,000 genomes project to verify this claim about rare variants.
Action 1: Search[1000 genomes project rare variants]
Observation 1: [1] The 1000 Genomes Project: Data Management and Community Access
The 1000 Genomes Project was an international research effort to establish the most detailed catalogue of human genetic variation. The project aimed to discover genetic variants with frequencies of at least 1% in the populations studied...

[2] A map of human genome variation from population-scale sequencing
By characterizing the geographic and functional spectrum of human genetic variation, the 1000 Genomes Project aims to build a resource useful for studies of common and rare variants...
Thought 2: The search mentions both common and rare variants. I should look up information specifically about rare variants and their penetrance.
Action 2: Lookup[rare variants]
Observation 2: (Result 1 / 2) Deep resequencing of GWAS loci identifies rare variants that may predispose to major depression and further suggests that rare variants of large effect may occur in genomic regions implicated by common variants.
Thought 3: This confirms that rare variants have larger penetrance effects than common variants, which supports the claim.
Action 3: Finish[SUPPORT]

Claim: ALDH1 expression is associated with poorer prognosis in breast cancer.
Thought 1: I need to search for information about ALDH1 and breast cancer prognosis.
Action 1: Search[ALDH1 breast cancer prognosis]
Observation 1: [1] ALDH1 is a marker of normal and malignant human mammary stem cells
ALDH1 is a detoxifying enzyme responsible for the oxidation of intracellular aldehydes. ALDH1 activity has been associated with breast cancer stem cells. Studies have shown that ALDH1-positive cells have increased tumorigenicity...
Thought 2: I should look up the specific relationship between ALDH1 and prognosis.
Action 2: Lookup[prognosis]
Observation 2: (Result 1 / 1) Expression of ALDH1 was correlated with reduced disease-free survival and overall survival, indicating worse clinical outcomes for patients with high ALDH1 expression.
Thought 3: The evidence shows ALDH1 is associated with worse outcomes (poorer prognosis), which supports the claim.
Action 3: Finish[SUPPORT]

Claim: Rapamycin treatment increases lifespan only in female mice.
Thought 1: I need to search for information about rapamycin and lifespan in mice.
Action 1: Search[rapamycin lifespan mice]
Observation 1: [1] Rapamycin fed late in life extends lifespan in genetically heterogeneous mice
Rapamycin, an inhibitor of the mTOR pathway, extends median and maximum lifespan of both male and female mice when fed beginning at 600 days of age...
Thought 2: The evidence says rapamycin extends lifespan in both male AND female mice, not only females.
